reviewer.name: Claude Opus 5.5
reviewer.method: Looked at rendered page images. Atlas labels and distinctiveness scores only helped to find pages; they did not set any score.

status.note: These are AI judgements of visual quality, not facts and not human decisions. human-curation.json holds human decisions only and is not touched by this file.

scale.note: rtl_bilingual is null where a page has no Arabic. mean_score averages the scored criteria only.

inspection_levels.full_size: atlas page image, 1100 px wide (1600 px for spreads)
inspection_levels.enlarged: atlas page image scaled to about 516 px wide (750 px for spreads)
inspection_levels.contact_sheet: contact sheet, about 144 to 184 px wide; composition only, text unreadable

review_coverage.caveat: A contact-sheet view shows composition only. Those pages were seen, but their text and fine detail were not assessed.

selection_summary.note: Quality and variety decided this, not equal representation. BI-05 stands for the shared template in BI-06 and BI-07.
